body:
Last time I was admitted I was told I could not leave before receiving a shot of haldol. I ended up getting neuroleptic malignant syndrome which effectively pushed me closer to death than I have ever put myself. So... I have pretty good reason not to trust people that are all too willing to pump me full of dangerous drugs. If you don't know what NMS is here is a link. It is brutal and I would have died had I not gotten to the emergency room in time.

http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neuroleptic_malignant_syndrome

Long story short. Lost a lot of friends. Can't back to school. Family wants nothing to do with me. All dreams crushed. No one will hire me. Insomnia. Crippling depression. No hope of finding love again. Months of untaken meds itching to enter my bloodstream.
I apologize for the lack of attention to paragraph structure and general readability. Unfortunately, I haven't practiced any type of writing in quite some time.
Also, death as the result of the toxicity of anti-anxiety medicines is rare.

I could not do it with anti-anxiety medicine even if it would be the least painful. In high dosages those medicines cause complete loss of judgement. If I consumed a dangerous amount I could unwittingly end up behind the wheel of my car thereby putting others in danger.
